messages.subject: error handling with tryCatch
parts:
Hey, 
A shiny application that I'm writing reads in objects of which the names are stored in an db.
over time some users have deleted these objects without deleting them in the db.
this returns the 'con' is not a connection error
I'm trying to catch this as follows:

if(is.null(input$runExperiment) || input$runExperiment == ""){
  output$reportRun <- renderUI(wellPanel(p("Select an experiment")))
}else{
  runId <- input$runExperiment
  tryCatch({
    p <- indir(as(runId, 'Oni'))
  }, error=function(e){
    output$reportRun <- renderUI(wellPanel(p("experiment directory not found")))
  }
  )

this doesn't seem to return renderUI(wellPanel(p("Select an experiment")))
what am I doing wrong?
